Grease Pencil Strokes

On the `Sketch` object's `Lines` layer, create frames at `1`, `10`, and `20`. On each of those frames, ensure the first stroke has the required point count and shape: frame `1` -> `8` points forming a straight line spanning roughly `x=-1` to `x=+1` with little `y`\`z` variation; frame `10` -> `12` points whose distance to the origin is about `1`; frame `20` -> `16` points with at least `3` sign changes in consecutive `y`-deltas. Save the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.blend`.
source: Blender Manual — Grease Pencil 2D Drawing in 3D
